actions.command: which python3 python; python3 --version; systemctl --version | head -1; ls /opt/blueprint 2>/dev/null; ls /var/lib/blueprint 2>/dev/null; systemctl list-unit-files | grep -i blueprint

actions.description: End-to-end contract test through the edge
actions.command:
set -e
echo "health: $(curl -s -w ' [%{http_code}]' http://127.0.0.1:8080/health)"
head -c 1024 /dev/urandom > /tmp/payload.bin
echo "put: $(curl -s -w ' [%{http_code}]' -X PUT --data-binary @/tmp/payload.bin http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/job-123)"
echo "get1: $(curl -s -w ' [%{http_code}]' http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/job-123 -o /tmp/out.bin)"
sleep 0.5
echo "get2: $(curl -s -w ' [%{http_code}]' http://127.0.0.1:8080/jobs/job-123 -o /tmp/out.bin)"
cmp /tmp/payload.bin /tmp/out.bin && echo "bytes match"
actions.output_excerpt:

put: accepted [202]
get1:  [409]
get2:  [200]
